Package neqsim.process.equipment.compressor

Class CompressorDepositProfile

java.lang.Object
neqsim.process.equipment.compressor.CompressorDepositProfile
public class CompressorDepositProfile extends Object
Locates where solid deposits form along a multi-impeller centrifugal compressor by marching the pressure-temperature path stage by stage and running a solid (TP-solid) precipitation flash at each impeller's local conditions.

Deposition happens where the local pressure and temperature cross the solubility / saturation limit of the depositing species. For a single compressor body the temperature rises monotonically from inlet to discharge, so a solubility-limited species such as elemental sulfur (S8) is most likely to drop out at the cold first impeller and re-dissolve toward the hotter last impeller; across a multi-stage train the gas re-cools in each intercooler and can re-cross saturation on the first impeller after each cooler. This profile makes that spatial picture explicit.

The stage pressures are interpolated geometrically between suction and discharge, and the stage temperatures linearly along the polytropic path (screening-level). For a rigorous per-stage fluid state, use the compressor's detailed polytropic method with a CompressorPropertyProfile and flash each captured stage fluid.

    • compute

      public static List<CompressorDepositProfile.StageDeposit> compute(StreamInterface inlet, double dischargeTemperatureC, double dischargePressureBara, int numberOfImpellers, String solidComponent)
      Compute the per-impeller solid-deposition profile between suction and discharge conditions.
      Parameters:
      inlet - compressor suction stream (defines the composition and suction T/P)
      dischargeTemperatureC - discharge temperature in Celsius
      dischargePressureBara - discharge pressure in bara
      numberOfImpellers - number of impellers (stages) to resolve (at least 1)
      solidComponent - name of the solid-forming component, for example "S8"
      Returns:
      one CompressorDepositProfile.StageDeposit per impeller from suction (stage 1) to discharge

    • computeFromPropertyProfile

      public static List<CompressorDepositProfile.StageDeposit> computeFromPropertyProfile(Compressor compressor, int numberOfImpellers, String solidComponent)
      Compute the per-impeller solid-deposition profile using the compressor's rigorous per-step fluid states captured by its CompressorPropertyProfile.

      Unlike compute(Compressor, int, String), which interpolates the stage pressures and temperatures (screening), this method flashes the actual fluid state that the compressor computed along the polytropic path, so each impeller uses the true local pressure, temperature and composition. Enable it before running the compressor: 

      
 compressor.setPolytropicMethod("detailed");
 compressor.getPropertyProfile().setActive(true);
 compressor.run();
 List<StageDeposit> profile = CompressorDepositProfile.computeFromPropertyProfile(compressor, 5, "S8");

      The captured steps (numberOfCompressorCalcSteps, default 40) are mapped onto the requested number of impellers. If the property profile is not active or empty this falls back to the screening compute(Compressor, int, String).

      Parameters:
      compressor - a compressor run with the detailed polytropic method and an active property profile
      numberOfImpellers - number of impellers (stages) to resolve (at least 1)
      solidComponent - name of the solid-forming component, for example "S8"
      Returns:
      one CompressorDepositProfile.StageDeposit per impeller from suction to discharge
